meta.title: 拍摄眼神控制不好？错误示范&正确示范
meta.title_en: Can't Control Your Eyes in Shots? Wrong vs. Right Demos
meta.topic: 表情管理 · 眼神拍摄

scenes.title_en: Wrong Eyes: Staring and Squeezing Shut
scenes.context: 拍摄眼神控制。错误示范：瞪着眼睛看镜头很凶；也不要闭眼。往上看、往两边看、往下看都不能乱做，往下看会变成闭眼的。这些表情都不能做。语域：模特教学，口令式示范。
sentences: 眼神不能这样，瞪着眼睛看镜头。
Don't make this face — staring wide-eyed at the lens.
staring wide-eyed（瞪着眼睛）
眼睛往上看、往两边看、往下看，一个都不要乱来。
Looking up, to the sides, or down — none of these should be random.
none of these（一个都不要）
这样往下看，其实是闭着眼睛的。
Looking down like this actually squeezes your eyes shut.
squeezes your eyes shut（闭眼）
paraphrase: 瞪眼 → stare wide-eyed / bulge your eyes
闭眼 → squeeze eyes shut / close eyes
scenes.speak: Don't make this face — staring wide-eyed at the lens. Looking up, to the sides, or down — none of these should be random. Looking down like this actually squeezes your eyes shut.

scenes.title_cn: 正确：头不动，眼睛放松看镜头
scenes.title_en: Right: Head Still, Eyes Relaxed at the Lens
scenes.context: 正确示范：头不动的时候，眼睛看镜头，放松。如果是双眼皮，双眼皮不要上扬，要往下放松。语域：模特教学，纠正口令。
sentences: 我头不动的时候，眼睛看镜头，放松。
With my head still, I look at the lens — relaxed.
with my head still（头不动）
双眼皮不要上扬，往下放松。
Don't let your double eyelids flare upward — keep them relaxed, downward.
flare upward（上扬）
就上下叠合一点点。
Just let the lids overlap ever so slightly.
overlap slightly（叠合一点点）
paraphrase: 头不动 → head still / keep the head steady
眼睛放松 → relaxed eyes / soft gaze
scenes.speak: With my head still, I look at the lens — relaxed. Don't let your double eyelids flare upward — keep them relaxed, downward. Just let the lids overlap ever so slightly.

scenes.title_cn: 可以往两边看，但不能太多
scenes.title_en: You Can Look Sideways — Just Not Too Far
scenes.context: 眼睛可以往两边看，但不能看太多。想象中间是一个点，一、二、三，看三个点就够了。看到四的时候眼白就越来越多。语域：模特教学，数字化口令。
sentences: 眼睛可以往两边看，但是不能看太多。
You can glance to the sides, but not too far.
glance to the sides（往两边看）
你想中间是一个点，一二三，看三个点就够了。
Think of the center as one point — one, two, three, three points is enough.
three points is enough（三个点就够了）
看到四的时候，眼白就越来越多了。
Go to four and too much white of the eye shows.
white of the eye（眼白）
paraphrase: 往两边看 → glance sideways / look to the sides
眼白过多 → too much eye white / whites showing
scenes.speak: You can glance to the sides, but not too far. Think of the center as one point — one, two, three, three points is enough. Go to four and too much white of the eye shows.

scenes.title_en: And Don't Overdo It — Watch the Eye White
scenes.context: 眼睛既不能往旁边看太多，也不能过度上挑，否则都会露出过多眼白。核心是控制眼神的方向和幅度，保持自然。语域：模特教学，收尾提醒。
sentences: 也不能注意，防止眼白。
Don't overdo it either — watch the eye white.
watch the eye white（防止眼白）
所以眼睛不能往旁边看太多。
So don't let your eyes drift too far to the side.
drift too far（看太多）
控制眼神的方向和幅度。
Control the direction and range of your gaze.
range of your gaze（眼神幅度）
paraphrase: 防止眼白 → watch the eye white / avoid showing too much white
眼神幅度 → range of your gaze / how far the eyes move
scenes.speak: Don't overdo it either — watch the eye white. So don't let your eyes drift too far to the side. Control the direction and range of your gaze.

practice: Staring wide-eyed at the lens looks fierce — don't make this face.
With my head still, I look at the lens — relaxed.
One, two, three — three points is enough; go to four and too much eye white shows.
Control the direction and range of your gaze.
pitfalls: Don't let your eyes fly up and down.
Don't let your eyes drift too far to the side.
「乱看」用 drift too far，不是 fly up and down。
Don't let your double eyelids flare upward.
「双眼皮上扬」用 flare upward，双-眼皮是 double eyelids。
Too much white of the eye shows.
「眼白」是 white of the eye，不是 white eyes。
One, two, three — three points is enough.
「看三个点」用 three points，不说 three o'clock。
shifts: 用 stare wide-eyed（瞪眼）、drift too far（看太多）、glance sideways（往两边看）
用 soft gaze（柔和眼神）、lids overlap（眼皮叠合）、head still（头不动）
用 range of your gaze（眼神幅度）、too much eye white（眼白过多）、control direction（控制方向）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：刷眼皮→双眼皮、上奏→上扬、拨散调→眼皮、注意→过度、眼白、三三个点→一 二 三、防制→防止等。
